NDT ERP in Martinez, California: the short answer

For NDT and inspection companies working in Martinez and the Contra Costa County refinery belt, the Atlantis ERP solution brings technician certificates, training records, instruments and calibration, crew dispatch, method-specific field reports, quotations and invoices into one system. It is configured around how your company already works, it runs in a browser and on a phone, and it is fully customizable. Pricing is quote on request, based on headcount and scope.

This section is for owners, operations managers, QA/QC managers and Level IIIs at inspection contractors along the Carquinez Strait and the northern shore of Contra Costa County. It covers what is particular about working here: some of the most heavily regulated refineries in the country, clients who expect contractors to prove training and qualification on demand, California's own labour and radiation rules, and turnaround schedules that do not forgive a missing certificate.

The Martinez inspection market

Martinez is the county seat of Contra Costa County and sits in the middle of one of the oldest refining clusters on the West Coast. Within a short drive a crew can reach several very different kinds of plant.

  • Martinez Refining Company: PBF Energy's refinery, formerly Shell's Martinez refinery, is rated at around 157,000 barrels per day. It went through a major rebuild after a fire in February 2025, and restart and rebuild work of that kind brings large inspection scopes on piping, vessels and heaters.
  • Renewable fuels: Marathon's former Golden Eagle refinery east of Martinez was converted to renewable diesel production and is run as Martinez Renewables, a joint venture with Neste. Across the county, the Phillips 66 Rodeo site has also moved to renewable fuels. Conversions like these bring new materials, new process conditions and new inspection requirements.
  • Other Bay Area refining and chemicals: Chevron's Richmond refinery, hydrogen plants operated by industrial gas suppliers next to the refineries, and chemical and terminal facilities along the strait and the Sacramento-San Joaquin delta shoreline.
  • Power, pipelines and fabrication: gas-fired power plants, pipeline work and fabrication shops across the East Bay and Solano County.

Every one of these clients audits contractors, and several of them are covered by rules that go further than federal requirements. NDT software for Martinez contractors has to make that evidence easy to produce.

Contra Costa and California rules that shape contractor records

Contra Costa County adopted its Industrial Safety Ordinance in 1998. It strengthens the California Accidental Release Prevention program for refineries and chemical plants and is administered by Contra Costa Health. The sites it covers include the Martinez Refining Company, Marathon's Golden Eagle site, the Phillips 66 Rodeo refinery and the hydrogen plants that serve them. On top of that, Cal/OSHA's process safety management regulation for petroleum refineries, Title 8 Section 5189.1, adds requirements on damage mechanism reviews, hierarchy of hazard controls and contractor safety.

California also requires refiners to use a skilled and trained workforce for certain contracted work under Health and Safety Code Section 25536.7, the 2013 law known as SB 54, which includes completion of advanced safety training for high-hazard facilities within the prior two years. Whether it applies to a given NDT scope is for you and your client to confirm, but many refinery clients ask for the training evidence either way.

The ERP does not interpret any of these rules for you. What it does is keep qualification, training, calibration and report records complete, dated and attached, so that when a client's contractor safety team or an auditor asks, you can produce them in minutes. Additional training records of this kind can be held as certificates under the "other" scheme with dates, hours and attachments.

Technician certification tracking software for refinery contractors

Refinery gates in Contra Costa County check contractor qualifications before anyone is badged, and a missing document stops a crew. Technician certification tracking software has to keep NDT certifications, vision tests and additional safety training current and visible.

Each certification in the Atlantis ERP records scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level from trainee to III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam results and attachments. Status is computed automatically as active, expiring soon within 90 days, expired or revoked, with menus for expiring and expired records. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours.

Vision tests are separate records with near vision to Jaeger J1 or J2, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, file and expiry. Examination sheets store general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70 percent. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test lapses, configurable daily email alerts go to whoever you choose, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. The employee NDT profile holds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. See the certificates app. To see your own qualification matrix loaded, ask for a certification tracking demo.

California radiography: radiographer cards, sources and vehicles

California is an NRC Agreement State, and industrial radiography is licensed by the California Department of Public Health's Radiologic Health Branch. California also requires industrial radiographers to hold a recognised radiation safety certification, such as a card from an Agreement State whose certification California accepts or the ASNT industrial radiography radiation safety personnel certification. For a contractor bringing RT crews from other states, keeping track of which card each radiographer holds is part of daily dispatch.

In the ERP these radiation safety certifications are recorded under the "other" scheme with dates and a scanned copy, beside each technician's NDT certifications, and the NDT profile carries radiation safety training, badge number and medical fitness expiry. The Fleet app records each vehicle's purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and assignments to projects and drivers with dates and mileage. RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement, and computed radiography has its own report type.

How your source inventory, utilisation logs and leak test records are organised for your licence is configured during implementation with your Radiation Safety Officer. The ERP holds the records; it does not replace the radiation safety programme.

Crew dispatch software for turnarounds and restarts

Refinery turnarounds, rebuilds and restarts in the Bay Area pull in large temporary crews on tight windows, and several plants can be down at once. Crew dispatch software has to show who is committed, who is free and which equipment is where, without anyone keeping it in their head.

In the Atlantis ERP each job is a team assignment that moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. Each technician has an availability calendar showing assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable; Time Off feeds it and overlapping entries are refused. Double-booking a technician is blocked, and so is double-booking an equipment serial number.

Operations sees each technician's status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date in calendar, kanban or list views. Training days booked on the calendar, including safety training that clients require, block assignments on those dates, so nobody is scheduled to a unit when they are meant to be in a classroom. See the team assignments app.

Calibration management software and equipment control

Refinery clients audit instrument calibration as closely as personnel records. Calibration management software needs to show, for any report, which serial number was used and that it was in calibration on the day.

The Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument and probe by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle stage: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed. Issue and return go through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded both ways. Reservations stop clashes and movements are logged. Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The calibration certificate register keeps the lab accreditation number, PDF and a valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Team assignments warn when assigned equipment is out of calibration, and reports and timesheet lines can carry the equipment serial.

The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, repairs, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacements with condition before and after. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, MT particles and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags. Purchase records vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab with accredited-lab flag, accreditation number and expiry, and order lines link to a specific serial. See the asset management app.

NDT reporting software for refinery and renewable fuels work

Refinery and renewable fuels clients want reports that are complete, signed and traceable to their work orders. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types, each with its own numbering: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography.

That covers the typical Contra Costa scopes. Piping and vessel surveys use UT thickness reports with readings by direction and UT reports with a probe calibration table. Heat exchanger bundles get IRIS and ECT. Alloy verification during rebuilds and conversions uses PMI, and weld procedures call for hardness, ferrite and PWHT records. Tank floors use MFL with scan mode and item lines. New and repaired welds use RT, PAUT with focal laws, and TOFD. Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation, and results are acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports run draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector field. Work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references are captured. Versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your branding, and Excel templates are filled by mapping fields to cells, so a refinery's own format is produced from the data. More on Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Offline field reporting inside the unit

Coverage inside process units, vessels and tanks is unreliable, and many refineries restrict devices in certain areas. Where devices are allowed, the Atlantis field app installs from the browser onto a phone or tablet and works without signal. Technicians pick the method, fill in the report, take photos, sign on screen and preview the PDF; drafts and photos are stored on the device and sync when there is a connection.

The field API lets each device pull the jobs assigned to that technician and the equipment issued to them, then submit and sync reports. How you handle device restrictions at specific client sites is configured during implementation.

Procedures and Level III approval

Refinery clients often review contractor procedures before work, and changes in materials or conditions, such as those that come with a renewable fuels conversion, can mean procedure revisions. The Atlantis ERP procedure register holds document number, revision, method (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more), scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and body text or an uploaded file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states. Prepared, reviewed and approved by are recorded with dates, approved revisions are locked, rejections need a reason, and every revision keeps a snapshot. Approvers receive email notifications and reminders. An AI-assisted first draft, falling back to a built-in template, handles routine documents, and a Level III reviews and approves every one. For written practice or procedure support, see NDT consulting. Atlantis training is SNT-TC-1A based.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for California labour rules

California's daily overtime rules mean that a long turnaround shift changes the cost of a job in a way a weekly timesheet will not show. If hours by type do not reach the invoice correctly, the contractor absorbs it.

Quotations record job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF; clients accept and sign online, and quotes become sales orders. Projects carry job type, site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, and safety induction and work permit fields. Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, multiplier for overtime or double time, site, client and equipment serial, with approval, and feed billing. How overtime is calculated for payroll is configured during implementation.

Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals and lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and days or hours. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over twelve months. California tax treatment is configured during implementation.

Affordable, customizable ERP for small NDT companies in the East Bay

Many East Bay inspection companies are small, and the Bay Area's costs make every non-billable hour count. An affordable ERP for a small NDT company should start with certificates, calibration, reports and invoicing, then add CRM and purchasing.

Implementation maps your methods, job types, qualification matrix, instruments and client formats, imports existing spreadsheets, sets up branded templates and pilots on live jobs. It runs in a browser and on phones, so there is nothing to host. For growth, the CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, scores leads 0 to 100, imports CSV lists and runs drip email sequences, and business cards photographed at industry events become leads. Surveys cover competency questionnaires and client feedback. The eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator support Level I and II trainees. To see it sized for your team, book a demo for a small East Bay NDT company.

Integrations with refinery and accounting systems

Refineries run large maintenance and procurement systems and some want inspection data delivered directly. The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. For clients who want to see results on the equipment, Atlantis Digital Twins maps indications and damage onto a 3D model and trends thickness and remaining life.

Frequently asked questions

Is there NDT ERP software for inspection companies in Martinez, CA?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP is built for NDT and inspection companies and is configured for your Martinez operation during implementation, covering certificates, training records, calibration, dispatch, field reports, quotations and invoicing. Quote on request.

Can it hold California radiation safety certifications for radiographers?

Yes. They are recorded as certificates under the "other" scheme with dates and a scanned copy, next to each technician's NDT certifications and radiation badge details.

Does the ERP make us compliant with the Industrial Safety Ordinance or Section 5189.1?

No software does that by itself. The ERP keeps the qualification, training, calibration and report records your clients and auditors ask for complete and easy to produce.

Can timesheets handle overtime and standby?

Yes. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup with billable flags and multipliers, and those hours feed invoice lines. Payroll overtime calculation is configured during implementation.

Does it support PMI and IRIS reporting for refinery work?

Yes. PMI, IRIS, ECT, hardness, ferrite, PWHT and UT thickness are among the 17 report types, each with its own numbering.

How do we get a quote?

Send your headcount, methods and main problem through the contact form. We will demo the system on your own job types and send a tailored quote. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable.
